tips: Load Suica to Apple/Google Wallet while waiting at the MSP gate — you'll breeze past the physical card machines on arrival.
Set your watch and phones to JST the moment you board DL 121; melatonin at 13:00 CT (4am JST) will fast-track your clock.

2026-12-15.weatherAlert: Tokyo December evenings are dry but brisk (often 5-8°C). The walk from Ichiran to Omoide Yokocho is short but chilly.
tips: Hit the Tokyo Metropolitan Gov't Building 45F deck (free, closes 22:00) for a night Fuji silhouette before your konbini nightcap.
If anyone crashes at 9pm, no shame — send a squadmate for konbini Pocari and sleep. Tomorrow is a marathon.

2026-12-16.weatherAlert: High risk of occasional December rain. Shibuya Blue Cave illumination and Shibuya Sky sunset slot are fully exposed.

suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Shibuya Hikarie 11F Sky Lobby (free) or Mag's Park rooftop
suggestedSwap.reason: If rain hits, Shibuya Sky outdoor decks will be miserable and fogged in; Hikarie offers a free, covered crossing view.

tips: If the rain hits, deploy the Miyashita Park covered rooftop + Parco + Tower Records alt to absorb a full wet afternoon.
Book Shibuya Sky tickets in advance regardless — December illumination season sells out fast, rain or shine.

2026-12-17.weatherAlert: Rain risk continues. Senso-ji and Nakamise are fine in drizzles, but Ueno Ameyoko market is partially exposed.

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: Ueno Ameyoko market under the tracks
suggestedSwap.reason: If it's pouring, the exposed Ameyoko stalls are a cold, wet slog; the museum is a 5-minute walk away and world-class.

tips: If Skytree queue is insane or it's too cold to wait, pivot to Asahi Beer Hall's 22F Sky Room next door for the same river view with a warm beer.
Hit Hoppy Street early — the day-drinking alley fills up fast with after-work locals by 17:00.

2026-12-18.crowdAlert: teamLab Planets is a guaranteed sell-out; ensure everyone has their Sept 18 booked tickets saved offline.
tips: Golden Gai bars seat 6-8 max; split into two squads of 4 to avoid 30-minute standing waits in the cold alleys.
Hit the Depachika raid at 15:00 sharp — that's when the high-end bento boxes start getting 20-30% off discount stickers.

2026-12-19.weatherAlert: Coastal Kamakura and Enoshima are highly exposed to winter winds and rain. Fuji-over-the-bay visibility requires a clear day.

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: Enoshima island — climb to the Sea Candle
suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Enospa onsen (soak with a Fuji view)
suggestedSwap.reason: If it's windy/rainy, the Sea Candle climb is freezing and Fuji will be invisible; Enospa offers a warm soak with bay views.

tips: If the forecast looks grim for the coast, pivot early to the Nikko or Kawaguchiko alt — December is peak Fuji clarity inland.
Grab a hot corn soup from a vending machine on the Enoden tram platform to keep hands warm.

2026-12-20.weatherAlert: Rain would dampen Inokashira Park and the Shimokitazawa vintage crawl.

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: Shimokitazawa — vintage maze + curry density record
suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Ikebukuro Sunshine City — 3,000-machine gachapon hall + Pokémon Center MEGA
suggestedSwap.reason: If it pours, Shimokita's outdoor vintage maze is a cold, wet drag; Sunshine City is fully covered and equally chaotic.

tips: Run the Airbnb washer during dinner so everyone lands in Kyoto with a clean kit — logistics IS culture.
Pack FIRST before the Golden Gai encore; bags must close tonight for the morning bullet train.
Grab ekiben at Tokyo Station's Matsuri store before boarding — the Nozomi doesn't have a dining car.
Sit on the LEFT side of the Nozomi (Seat E) for the Fuji window at minute 40 out of Tokyo.

2026-12-22.weatherAlert: Fushimi Inari at dawn in December is exceptionally cold (often near freezing at the summit).

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: FUSHIMI INARI AT DAWN — the whole reason alarms exist
suggestedSwap.reason: If it's raining heavily, the Inari mountain trails become slippery, cold, and the views are nil; Sanjusangendo is indoor and jaw-dropping.

tips: Layer up for Fushimi Inari — it's a 233m elevation gain and the summit is significantly colder than the base.
If doing Inari, go past Yotsutsuji where crowds hit zero; the full summit loop buys a deserted mountain.

2026-12-23.weatherAlert: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove is miserable in December rain (slippery, crowded with umbrellas); Nara deer are less active in the wet.

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove before the buses exist
suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Hokokuji bamboo temple with matcha counter
suggestedSwap.reason: If it rains, the Arashiyama grove is a crowded, slippery umbrella-war; Hokokuji offers a covered matcha seat inside a quieter bamboo grove.

2026-12-23.crowdAlert: Wakakusa-yama mountain climb is closed for the winter (closes second Sunday of December) — do not attempt the hike.
tips: Kinkaku-ji in low winter sun is spectacular, but if Kyoto wakes up white, deploy the Snow Protocol and go there immediately.
Bow to the Nara deer first, show empty hands when done — they understand the gesture and will chase you if you run.

2026-12-24.crowdAlert: KFC Christmas buckets sell out fast; pre-order or arrive right at 18:00 to secure the sacred tradition.
tips: If all 8 lost the Nintendo Museum lottery, pivot to Byodo-in and Tsuen tea in Uji — it's Japan's matcha capital for a reason.
Buy Rikuro's jiggly cheesecake near Namba station — buy two, they do not survive the night.

2026-12-25.crowdAlert: USJ on Christmas Day will be at peak capacity; Express Passes are mandatory for a group of 8 to avoid 3-hour Mario Kart lines.
tips: Rope-drop SUPER NINTENDO WORLD at gate-cross — if Express Passes are sold out, use the app timed-entry sprint + single-rider lines.
If Kinopio's Café is full, Yoshi snack stand + Power-Up Band challenges still deliver the serotonin.

2026-12-26.weatherAlert: Miyajima island is highly exposed to coastal winds; the floating torii is best at high tide, which needs timing.
tips: Check the Miyajima tide chart in the morning — the torii 'floating' effect requires high tide; at low tide you can walk up to it on sand.
This is the longest day of the trip. Anyone redlining should skip Miyajima, do the museum unhurried, and meet at Hiroshima station.

2026-12-27.weatherAlert: Midosuji Illumination is a 4km outdoor walk; Osaka December evenings are dry but near freezing.
tips: Grab a 551 Horai butaman 4-pack from Namba station BEFORE the crab dinner — they sell out nightly and house breakfast depends on it.
If Umeda Sky Building is too cold or crowded, Abeno Harukas (Japan's tallest) is a great indoor sunset swap.

2026-12-28.weatherAlert: Himeji Castle is an outdoor, exposed climb with no elevators; December winds at the top tier are biting.
tips: Kobe beef budget fork: Sannomiya croquette stands deliver 70% of the experience at 40% of the price if sit-down lunch is booked.
Do your tax-free paperwork check tonight — ensure receipts are with passports and purchases are accessible for customs on exit.
Sit on the LEFT side (Seat A) of the Nozomi for Fuji's encore as you head back to Haneda.
Zero-out your Suica cards at the konbini and buy final boss gachapon at the gate — leftover yen is wasted yen.

globalTips: With USD/JPY at ~161.85, your dollar stretches far — avoid exchanging cash at airport booths with high fees; withdraw directly from 7-Eleven ATMs for the best rates.

December evenings in Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka are dry but consistently near freezing (2-8°C). Pack a windproof outer layer; the real enemy is the wind chill at exposed spots like Fushimi Inari, Miyajima, and Umeda Sky Building.
For a group of 8, always split into two squads of 4 for bars, small restaurants, and karaoke — it eliminates 30-minute wait times and keeps the group nimble.
